hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; c=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // \"\""); printf "%s" "$c" | grep -qE "(^|[;&|[:space:]])gh +pr +create" || exit 0; printf "%s" "$c" | grep -qi "adversarial review" && exit 0; bf=$(printf "%s" "$c" | sed -n "s/.*--body-file[= ]*\([^ ]*\).*/\1/p"); if [ -n "$bf" ] && [ -f "$bf" ] && grep -qi "adversarial review" "$bf"; then exit 0; fi; echo "review gate (AGENTS.md 'How we develop'): PR bodies must include an '## Adversarial review' section — run the skeptic subagent on the staged diff, fix or pin its findings, and for bug fixes verify the regression test FAILS on pre-fix code. Put the section in --body (or the --body-file file) and retry." >&2; exit 2
